lines.text: Every app, game and website runs on algorithms. Today you’ll learn to write instructions a computer can follow exactly.
An algorithm is a precise, step-by-step set of instructions to solve a problem.
Recipes, directions and dance routines are all algorithms.
A computer does exactly what you say, in exactly the order you say it — never what you meant.
Swap two steps and you can get a completely different result.
The same idea in Python’s turtle module looks like: forward(100), right(90), forward(50).
Blocks and text code share the same thinking.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
